import sys
from collections import Counter

def solve():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    if not s:
        return
    
    freq = Counter(s)
    min_freq = min(freq.values())
    
    result = [c for c in s if freq[c] == min_freq]
    print(''.join(result))

solve()
